fields.description: First half of the 16-byte ROM ID header; written byte-by-byte to EWRAM 0x02000000-0x02000007 and verified as u32 word 0 in the save-load path.
fields.evidence: FUN_0808e9c4 writes uRam02000000..uRam02000007 ('AGB-P-AA'); FUN_0808eabc loads EEPROM block 0 via FUN_080a34e8(0, 0x2000000) and compares iRam02000000/iRam02000004 against ROM constants DAT_0808eb40/DAT_0808eb44.
fields.name: save_magic_line_a

fields.description: Second half of the 16-byte ROM ID header including the 0xFF terminator; written to EWRAM 0x02000008-0x0200000F and verified as u32 words 2-3 on load.
fields.evidence: FUN_0808e9c4 writes uRam02000008..uRam0200000f ('SJ(JPN)' + 0xFF); FUN_0808eabc loads EEPROM block 1 via FUN_080a34e8(1, 0x2000008) and compares iRam02000008/iRam0200000c against DAT_0808eb48/DAT_0808eb4c.
fields.name: save_magic_line_b

fields.description: First 32-bit word of the game-data arena immediately after the header; zero in a fresh init. Interior semantics are not exposed by this decomp slice.
fields.evidence: FUN_0808e9c4 bulk-writes EEPROM blocks 0..N from EWRAM 0x02000000+i*8 (block 2 maps to save offset 16); baseline shows offset 16 zeroed. Block transfer primitives FUN_080a34e8/FUN_080a3598/FUN_080a3674.
fields.name: arena_data_first_word

fields.description: Low byte of the halfword fetched from EEPROM block 0x17a; companion to validity_marker. Zero in the fresh baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_0808ecac fetches EEPROM block 0x17a into stack via FUN_080a34e8(0x17a, auStack_10) + FUN_080a3674 verify; save offset 0xBD0 is the low byte of auStack_10[0] (little-endian).
fields.name: validity_word_low

fields.description: Validity marker byte: the save is treated as provisioned when this byte equals 0x21; fresh baseline holds 0x00.
fields.evidence: FUN_0808ecac returns (auStack_10[0] >> 8 == 0x21) after FUN_080a34e8(0x17a) loads the block; high byte of the LE halfword at save offset 0xBD0 is byte 0xBD1.
fields.name: validity_marker

fields.description: Last 32-bit word of the zero-written arena; anchors the observed arena end at offset 0x19D0 (block 0x339 written, rest erased 0xFF).
fields.evidence: FUN_0808e9c4 DMA-clears EWRAM via func_0x080a32cc then bulk-writes blocks 0..N with FUN_080a3598/FUN_080a3674; baseline logical bytes 16..0x19D0 are 0x00 and 0x19D0..0x2000 are 0xFF (0x19D0 = 826 blocks).
fields.name: arena_data_last_word

title: World Advance Soccer - Shouri e no Michi (Japan)
